scenarios.title: Artemis: Crewed Lunar Landing
scenarios.brief: Put a crew on the Moon and bring them home. Fit the whole stack on a documented lunar rocket, keep the dose under NASA's career limit, and give the crew real time on the surface.

objectives.label: The stack fits the rocket's documented TLI payload
At least 3 days of surface work

scenarios.title: Habitat in a Can
scenarios.brief: A lunar habitat has to keep four people alive for months without resupply. Close the air and water loops and prove the surface stay is sustainable.

objectives.label: The habitat stack fits the rocket
Regenerative life support carries the load

scenarios.title: First Boots on Mars
scenarios.brief: The headline mission. Get humans to Mars and back inside the radiation career limit without letting the mission drag on for years.

objectives.label: The stack fits the launch vehicle

scenarios.title: Recycling on Mars
scenarios.brief: Everything the crew drinks, breathes and eats has to be recycled or grown. Push the closed-loop life-support budget as far as it will go on a long surface stay.

objectives.label: At least 30 days to run the loops

scenarios.title: Mars Outpost One
scenarios.brief: A long-duration outpost, one full synodic stay. The crew will be exposed to deep-space radiation for years — make every gram and every day count.

objectives.label: A super-heavy stack leaves the pad

scenarios.title: Lunar Express
scenarios.brief: A fast crewed dash to the Moon: small crew, short stay, efficient transfer. Speed is the objective — the clock and the Δv both matter.

objectives.label: A lean stack on a lunar rocket

scenarios.title: Gateway Assembly
scenarios.brief: Build the lunar Gateway station piece by piece. Multiple launches, international modules, and a regenerative life-support system that must work from day one. No crew until the stack closes.

objectives.label: Each module fits its launch vehicle
Regenerative life support closes the loop

scenarios.title: Phobos First
scenarios.brief: Land on Phobos before Mars. Lower Δv than a Mars landing, natural radiation shelter in Stickney Crater, and a staging point for the surface. A smarter first step to the Red Planet.

objectives.label: The stack fits the launch vehicle

scenarios.title: Cargo to Surface
scenarios.brief: Deliver 100+ tonnes of ISRU gear, habitat modules, and power systems to Mars — uncrewed. Starship-only, fully reusable, proving the logistics chain before humans arrive. The ultimate stress test for entry, descent, and landing.

scenarios.title: Artemis II and You!
scenarios.brief: Fly the first crewed Artemis mission around the Moon. Orion on SLS Block 1, 4 crew, 10-day free-return trajectory. No landing — but the view is historic.

objectives.label: Orion + SLS Block 1 fits TLI payload
